importantLimits: Prescribed rigid disc-condyle cluster; natural lower-space rolling is not represented.
Continuous hard-source collision and bounded whole-instrument sweeps; soft-cavity self-intersections sampled at midpoint/end of each admitted step.
20 nm extent/penetration tolerance for Float32 Boolean slivers; no historical penetration allowance.
Uniform pressure and well-mixed tracer in one connected upper domain; uncalibrated scalar wall law, no CFD/cavitation/leakage or clinical pressure inference.
Geometric checks run slower than simulation time; queued requests interrupt after the next admitted small step.
